name: Karura Forest waterfall and caves
why: Inside Nairobi: forest paths to a waterfall and the Mau Mau caves, with monkeys and many birds.
book: Ticket at the Limuru Road gate (Friends of Karura).
dangers: Slippery near the falls after rain.

points.name: Karura Forest gate
points.note: The main gate on Limuru Road.

points.name: Karura Waterfall
points.note: A 15 m waterfall on the Karura river, next to the Mau Mau caves.
